title: Pinwheel Tablecloth Pattern #7064
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #95 New Table Settings (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Starting at center, ch 8, join with sl st to form ring." replaced by magic ring. Only the First Block kept; joining of blocks and tablecloth edging omitted. Original heading "7th, 8th and 9th rnds:" written as "Round 7-9:". Swirling dc wedges (skip first dc of each group, 2 dc in next loop) that are squared off on rnds 10-12. R12 'sc between the 2-sc' written as a bare sc. pattern.dsl left EMPTY: a full DSL is in pattern.dsl.draft and agrees with the pattern (R2 has 16 ch-1 sps, R3 8 groups of 2 dc), but the checker reads the vintage stated counts '(16 sps)' and '(8 groups of 2-d c)' as unknown stitch names and reports a mismatch; the published wording was kept. DSL: the agent's draft, left out of staging only because the checker misreads this page's stated counts; check the counts by hand.
